about_the_game:
Cultivate Superstars: Your Street, Your Legend

Step into the role of a mastermind, guiding a player from rookie status to a court-dominating superstar. Plan every detail of their journey through rigorous training and competitions to amass experience, unlock their potential, and tailor their growth path. Enhance their skills and attributes comprehensively, and your strategic decisions could birth the next Street Legend!

We're redefining the game: height is no longer a barrier, and position no longer a constraint. Every player you develop can become a versatile powerhouse, free from glaring weaknesses. Imagine a 2.15-meter center pulling off a nimble crossover under the streetlights or a 1.6-meter dynamo dazzling tall defenders with dreamlike footwork. Are you ready to revolutionize the court?

Join the PVE challenge tournament to claim your title as the king of street basketball!

This is the ultimate honor in the streetball world, a dream stage for countless enthusiasts. Choose your star player, assemble the strongest team, and battle through the preliminaries to reach the main event. Face off against community giants, dominate local arenas, advance to the national championship, and ultimately stand on the global stage, basking in glory!

Let's dive into this relentless battle! Whether you're facing setbacks or pushing forward, each challenge breaks your own limits. You'll be amazed as your skills improve at a staggering pace and the players you've nurtured soar like arrows from a bow. Of course, generous rewards await those who triumph, providing the ultimate commendation for challengers. The championship trophy stands alone—who will etch their legend into history this time?

Easy-to-master street feel, returning to the true joy of basketball

The game attempts to recreate the signature moves of legendary real-life basketball players: a Euro step to gracefully bypass defenders for a smooth layup; a set of dreamlike footwork followed by a spin and skyhook under the basket; a one-legged fadeaway that renders the opponent's block futile. Moreover, in critical moments, you will experience the recreation of countless classic moments, like a seemingly impossible 3-point shot taken under heavy defense.

Simple and easy-to-master controls with seamless action transitions are our relentless pursuit, aiming to make every dribble, direction change, and shot feel fluid and effortless.

Every brilliant combo is worth recording, and in the game, you can replay your highlight moments at any time. Whether it's a deadly crossover that fells your opponent or a timely chase-down block, every clip is a bragging right!

Host online tournaments and compete with top players worldwide

Excitingly, the in-game 'Self-hosted Tournament System' is already taking shape. With continuous upgrades and iterations, it will empower you to become an event organizer, customize match rules, invite friends to participate, and create your own basketball extravaganza!

In the future, the game plans to establish a global league competition system, providing a stage for top players worldwide to engage in peak duels and exchange skills. In the near future, you will not only be able to compete with players from around the world and win generous rewards, but also meet like-minded basketball enthusiasts and fight side by side. A comprehensive promotion system and fair competition mechanism ensure that every match is both intense and exciting, as well as full of fun.

Creating a diverse ecosystem, where everyone is a dream maker

In "FREE DUNK," everyone is the hero of their own basketball saga. Whatever role you choose, you can embark on a unique journey in the world of basketball.

Be a hardcore player, sharpening your skills through intense competitions and reveling in the pure thrill of the game. Become a basketball guru, sharing tips and insights while building a dedicated fan base. Take on the role of a club manager, cultivating new talent, recruiting players, and crafting your own championship-winning team. Or step into the shoes of a trendsetter, joining co-creation initiatives, designing distinctive looks, and leading the street basketball fashion scene.

Here, there are no rigid player hierarchies—just the passionate blend of basketball spirit. In "FREE DUNK," basketball transcends being a mere game; it's a celebration of endless possibilities. Join us in crafting your own street legend!
detailed_description:
Dev Letter

These scenes are all too real for basketball lovers: the sting of a finger jab during a steal, a star player nailing a massive triple-double and capturing everyone's admiration, the explosion of chatter in a fan group when a trade hits the news, and the heated debates over who currently holds the title of the best shooting guard in the league. In "FREE DUNK," we strive to encapsulate these passionate and exhilarating moments in every pixel.

Yet, creating this experience is infinitely more complex than mastering a crossover move back in the day. Beyond our passion for the game, we need to sharpen our 'inner skills': the game must be intuitive and smooth, the art style unique with striking character models. The player development system should be rich and varied, enabling you to build your own superstar. A balanced and orderly game ecosystem is crucial to ensure everyone can compete fairly. These challenges are our primary focus, and we know that every basketball journey starts with airballs and missed backboards.

As we approach the upcoming game test, anticipation is mixed with a touch of anxiety. We understand that "FREE DUNK," from its initial idea to its current form, will undergo countless revisions and refinements. We're ready for that. Believe us when we say that this dedicated team will never stop improving the game. The harsh critiques from the community, the cries of "this feature is brutal" on live streams, and even the optimization suggestions sent at three in the morning will all be noted and displayed on our 'wall of shame' in the office. After all, only true friends on the streetball court will candidly say, "Buddy, you've got a long way to go."

Without realizing it, basketball has seeped into our very being, becoming an integral part of who we are.

—— THE 'FREE DUNK' TEAM
